name: N-DGS Bounded Cholesky Parameterization
definition: N-DGS parameterizes the joint covariance using bounded Cholesky coefficients multiplied by query diagonal scales to control spatial extent and cross-covariance.
summary: N-DGS Bounded Cholesky Parameterization controls 3D Gaussian covariance using bounded Cholesky coefficients and query scales, implicitly deriving the regression operator from the joint Cholesky factor rather than optimizing operational quantities directly.
